Exclude Gulf of Mexico Loop Current,Antilles flow east of Bahamas,downstream Gulf Stream and family-level Gulf Stream System as target identities. Mainland/Bahamas shallow or dry support can limit the window; broad maxima do not independently establish the current axis. Seabed depth and deepest wet sample are not substituted for a velocity-contour bottom. Existing27N Spray fitted means/phases are separate source context,not simultaneous independent validation.

Partial northward eastern Irminger Sea branch along the western Reykjanes Ridge flank, 56–65 N editorial gates. Source describes two cores and intermediate return flow; one local integral maximum is not their summed transport, a uniquely tracked core or a whole-current section. Source also includes deeper northward IC water: a connected velocity contour does not separate upper mode water from deep water masses. Exclude return toward Greenland, North Icelandic continuation, interior gyre circuits, opposite ridge-side current and detached eddies as target identities; broad gates do not independently resolve them.

method: Frozen unique paired finite depth contours and linear transverse strips between original consecutive native longitude columns only; native-supported first-to-last contiguous model depth span retained even where boundaries are censored.
minimum_span_interpretation: Minimum support is conditional on the original contiguous piecewise-linear signed-component model definition. It is not a physical named-current thickness bound. A single supported level gives zero minimum support, not zero thickness or flow absence.
range_interpretation: Sampling-bracket geometry scenarios, not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty, annual envelopes or guaranteed true-area bounds.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Discrete original model-selected axis proxies only; eleven unresolved source cases retain null anchors and original candidate diagnoses. No between-section interpolation, stronger replacement core, current identity promotion or volume.
interpretation: Partial regional model-component depth shapes at each owner original primary cutoff (Portugal0.02m/s,others0.1m/s); areas from different cuts/dates/owners are not additive water volume. Missing support stays unknown.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source methods,owners and branch scope retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
